ticket: Board overhaul #42 (independent review P1, Linux X670)
defect: A human manual block stored before schema 13 had no blocked_reason after migration and was released as a ghost by the first get_work
change: Before releasing a reasonless block without recheck, the reevaluation reads the ticket audit: when the latest status-changing event is a human ticket_updated naming status, the block is kept with reason 'Blocked manually by <name>', unblock_owner set to that human and no recheck; a legacy_block_classified event is recorded

Status-neutral events (messages, progress, reviews, executions, runtime, profile refresh) are skipped; any other latest event, including agent updates and releases, keeps the previous release behaviour
Classification runs on every reevaluation, so databases already migrated to schema 13 are covered too

verification.board_tests: 934 passed (933 + test_upgrade_keeps_a_human_manual_block_from_before_schema_13, which drops the schema-13 columns, reopens the database through the real migration and polls; it fails on 0090da0)

reviewer_probe.description: Linux X670 migration_probe.py: schema-12 database created with the e390183 API (human update_ticket status=blocked), then reopened and polled

limits: The audit records which fields an update changed, not their values; a block written outside the API after a human status update would be classified as human (no API path does this)
Tickets already released in production by 2.11-2.12.1 are not re-blocked; Studio #3 and retention #14 were restored by hand and carry explicit reasons
